response.justification: While Bogdan is a technically accomplished engineer with 20 years of software development experience and relevant exposure to developer tools and infrastructure, he critically lacks the people management experience required for this role. The position explicitly requires 2 years in a people-leadership or team management role, which is entirely absent from his resume. There is no evidence of managing direct reports, conducting performance reviews, or leading teams. His 'Staff' titles appear to reflect individual-contributor seniority rather than management responsibility. For a 'full-time people-leadership role,' this gap is disqualifying.
strengths: Extensive polyglot software engineering background (20 years) with deep expertise in testing, TDD, and code quality practices aligned with engineering productivity
Direct hands-on experience with developer tooling including CI/CD infrastructure, code generators (MCP), testing frameworks (Fluent-Asserts, Trial), and build system components
Strong track record of knowledge-sharing and mentorship through workshops, technical talks, and active open-source community contributions demonstrating communication ability
concerns: Completely lacks demonstrated people management experience despite the role requiring 2 years in such a capacity with no mention of direct reports or team leadership
No evidence of setting team priorities, conducting performance management, or leading organizational change initiatives critical to the mid-senior manager role

Developer tools experience, while present, is fragmented across various projects and timeframes; may not meet the 3-year dedicated requirement for building scalable build systems and test infrastructure

key_factors.factor: Strong technical and developer tools background
Lack of documented team leadership track record
